inspection.name: Probe 1: Pronoun / Entity Resolution
inspection.text: Sherlock Holmes sat in his armchair, smoking his pipe. The visitor knocked on the door and asked for help.

inspection.name: Probe 2: Quotation & Dialogue Discourse
inspection.text: He said: “It is an extraordinary problem, my dear Watson, but we shall solve it.”

inspection.name: Probe 3: Subordinate Clause & Causality
inspection.text: The doctor hurried away because the patient had suddenly collapsed in the garden.
